name: South Korean Election Campaign Booklets
description: Enriched campaign booklet artifact using the same document-row universe as the original CSV source, with conservative NEC linkage fields such as 'huboid', 'sg_id', and 'sg_typecode' added to improve interoperability with kr-elections-mcp and related NEC-aligned workflows.
variant_description: The same document-row universe as the original CSV source, plus conservative NEC linkage fields for integration workflows.
recommended_use: NEC-aligned workflows, kr-elections-mcp, and linkage-aware joins.

columns.name: office
columns.description: Office type label (president, national_assembly, metro_head, basic_head, metro_assembly, basic_assembly, education_superintendent)

columns.name: party_eng
columns.description: Political party name (English); transliteration if no official English name

columns.name: age
columns.description: Age at the time of the election

columns.name: job_id
columns.description: Original NEC job category identifier (varies across years)

columns.name: job_code
columns.description: Standardized job code consistent across years

columns.name: edu_id
columns.description: Original NEC education level identifier (varies across years)

columns.name: edu_code
columns.description: Standardized education code consistent across years

columns.name: pages
columns.description: Number of pages in the booklet

columns.name: huboid
columns.description: Linked NEC candidate identifier used for conservative kr-elections-mcp alignment; unresolved rows remain NA

columns.name: sg_id
columns.description: Linked NEC election identifier used for NEC-aligned workflows

columns.name: sg_typecode
columns.description: Linked NEC election type identifier used for NEC-aligned workflows

columns.name: link_status
columns.description: Linkage status for NEC alignment (resolved, ambiguous, not_found, rejected)

columns.name: matcher_version
columns.description: Version of the linkage pipeline used to assign NEC fields

columns.name: nec_snapshot_id
columns.description: Identifier of the NEC snapshot used to assign NEC fields

columns.name: text
columns.description: Full OCR-extracted text of the campaign booklet

columns.name: filtered
columns.description: Parsed text after morphological analysis; Korean-only, numbers, foreign characters, and symbols removed

notes.missing_values: 2,283 rows have no booklet code or text because a booklet was not available. 151 are missing biographical information. 23 booklets were unprocessable.
notes.text_processing: All text is UTF-8 encoded Korean. 'text' contains the full original text; 'filtered' contains the morphologically parsed version.
notes.identifiers: 'code' is the krpoltext document row identifier, but some rows have missing code values, so row identity should not be inferred from code alone. 'huboid' is a linked NEC identifier, not a native krpoltext identifier. Rows with 'link_status == "resolved"' are expected to have a non-null 'huboid'. 'sg_id' and 'sg_typecode' describe the NEC-aligned election scope attached to the row. 'job_id' and 'edu_id' vary across election years; use 'job_code' and 'edu_code' for cross-year analysis.
notes.provenance: The enriched variant is a row-preserving transformation of the original campaign_booklet CSV source. It adds conservative NEC linkage metadata to improve interoperability with kr-elections-mcp and related NEC-aligned workflows.
notes.artifact_transition: When the enriched campaign_booklet artifact is rebuilt or republished, update registry checksums, sizes, and URLs in lockstep with this schema.

extras.row_universe: Same document-row universe as the original campaign_booklet CSV source; some rows have missing code values.
